summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(title); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title once per control; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated on is_terminal like show_cursor; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only renderer test). Not verified: tests were not run and Black was not run (not installed; line lengths checked by reading). Nothing committed.
